cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - RoundedTrapezoidBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Trapezoid box with rounded vertical edges.
The x and y measurements are for a trapazoid with sharp corners. The radii cut the corners so the actual width is smaller for all trapazoids except rectangles.
![Two boxes side by side](static/samples/RoundedTrapezoidBox-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes RoundedTrapezoidBox --x_front 120 --x_back 100 --y 90 --h 50 --radius_front_left 4 --radius_front_right 4 --radius_back_right 4 --radius_back_left 4 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes RoundedTrapezoidBox --x_front --y --h --radius_front_left --radius_front_right --radius_back_right --radius_back_left --reference
